verdict.tagline: Terrifying co-op survival marred by connection demands and server hiccups.
for_you_if: you want tense cooperative horror with flexible progression
you enjoy earning cosmetics through sustained play
not_for_you_if: you need reliable offline solo play
you object to artificial intelligence asset generation

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: New players discover basic survival mechanics like throwing items to deter pursuers.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that players can throw items like bottles or bricks at enemies to stun or deter them.

citations.review_text: This game is insanely fun, you get chased around by naked old men and can throw the old mans empty beer bottles at him to get him off of your friends. Also, anyone complaining about the usage of ai by Red Barrel doesn't understand that it cuts costs, which in todays climate is the singular most important angle for game creation, and it allows an otherwise small team to focus their resources on the game itself while still providing textures and art that fit with the overall theme. AI is here, it's staying, it's just a part of life. Complaining about it is like asking those in the industrial revolution to ignore the machines that will either replace them or make them millions if utilized correctly
Some scary people chase you, but like real life, if you throw a brick at them it typically scares em off, or atleast stuns them.

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Initial sessions involve online connection demands and manual file adjustments for field of view.

claims.claim: The game requires an online connection to play, resulting in lost mission progress and disconnection issues during solo sessions.

citations.review_text:
Potential: 10/10
Fun: 8/10
Mechanics: 7/10
Lore: 10/10
Immersion: 9/10

Overall = 8/10

This is the kind of videogame that you're playing when your parents enter your bedroom without notice. Outlast Trials is gruesome, explicit, dark and twisted, in 5 years they will do a graphical enhancement and people will share clips of this game online calling it a censored snuff film...and that's what makes this game so great. The devs allow themselves to create an experience that respects the nature of the saga, this is a world where cruelty rules, people die and don't have any chances and the powerful are empty-stomach starving from power and ego. Sorry for speaking about reality, back to the game! It's awesome, mechanics are basic but polished, very flexible playstyle and truly fun to play with friends, challenges create variety and i appreciate that not all trials are the same, with shorter variants and different endings to obtain. Also love the rebirth mechanic, throws me back to COD prestige days, content and DLCs are fair for the price and they don't affect gameplay or core functionality, mad respect to the RB for that. However, the fact that the game relies exclusively on an online connection is WILD to me, the fact that you can be about to complete a trial in psychosurgery all alone to get disconnected from the game due to some minuscule wifi in-out is nuts. I really hope that the devs provide a future patch so the game can be run offline for the solo experience, other than that, it's an absolute gem and a statement against the industry losing personality over generic best-sellers
horrid servers im in a mision for A HOUR and the game servers lose connection and wipes all the progress

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a battle pass system that allows players to go back and access past battle passes.

citations.review_text: Just an overall well rounded game that is fun either solo or with friends. I like how they let you go back and get past battle passes when most companies do not allow that.

Caught it at $12 on the summer sale expecting a few quick nights of yelling with friends. There is so much more here than that. It is genuinely fun to switch between stealth, chases, and fleeting moments of defense while juggling objectives and cooperation with your friends. It is the kind of game that makes moments to talk about later and laugh at.

Good progression with a generous enough battle pass and customization system, a bit of build crafting to keep things fresh, and a good heavy load of content between its ten or so trial environments and the plentiful 15 minute remixes of those. They say escalation is the best mode once you've played the normal trials enough, but on a good sale this is absolutely worth everything that comes before that. Best served with crossplay and friends that don't game much.

claims.claim: Reviewers report having to manually adjust the field of view in game files because there is no in-game FOV slider.

citations.review_text: Very refreshing game, like it very much. Only one flaw: had to turn the FOV up in the Gamefiles, cause theres no FOV-slider in the settings... Without higher FOV, i would get motion sickness from playing.
please add quick restart or skip cutscene button... it takes like 5 minutes to restart a mission because of all the fanfare lmao. great game though

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Midway through, participants encounter artificial intelligence asset generation alongside cosmetic unlocks.

claims.claim: The game includes cosmetics and bundles that can be bought with real money, while gameplay unlocks and seasonal cosmetic catalogs can be earned through gameplay.

citations.review_text:
Probably the best multiplayer horror game out there. Differentiates itself from the leagues of 'friend-slop' streamer bait horror, as well as cash-grab AAA live service games. Actual gameplay is a ton of fun, and has deeper mechanics and a much higher skill ceiling than the walking-sim/stealth horror sub-genre (which includes the prior Outlast games). I also love the lore/vibe of the game: you are unknowingly recruited/kidnapped into participating in the most horrific MK-Ultra research trials imaginable.

By now, Outlast Trials also has a TON of content to get through (and lots of replayability). While irl money can be used to purchase limited in-game currency (coins), which in turn are only used to buy cosmetics, virtually all cosmetics can technically be earned without spending irl money. As long as you save coins earned from each of the main season cosmetic catalogs to unlock the next main season catalog, all of the main catalogs can be earned just through gameplay. Limited-event cosmetic catalogs can also be earned just through gameplay, as long as they are earned while the event is ongoing. Irl money is only needed if you want to purchase limited catalogs after the event has expired (again, the main catalogs are always available to be earned through just gameplay). Importantly, these limited coins only apply to cosmetics; meaning ALL gameplay unlocks and content are accessible without touching any irl money.

Its hard to say if i recommend this game or not, i wish steam would add athird option on the rating system that is more neutral.
 talking about the game, unfortunately its filled with gooner content and pay options for cosmetics, the events lack creativity, the maps are the same, the gooner content is just weird but eventho these things are heavy negatives the game has a funny lobby, you can change your room, your skins, the achievements for leveling are cool, you have chess and more mini games, like I mentioned the games are repetetive sometimes, but they are still fun, sometimes a 15 minute level can take 30-40 minutes if you haven't much gamesense. IMHO buy it on sale or buy it and refund it before 2 hours if it aint your taste, i wish for the game to be less sexual and more scary, i also wish for it to be more friendly with skins and collectables, the game costs money, so its annoying feeling like u didn't buy the full game.

claims.claim: Development of the game involves the use of AI-generated content and assets.

citations.review_text:
AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Throughout the development of our game, we may leverage AI-based tools to assist our team in content creation. Please rest assured that what you see in the game reflects the creativity and hard work of our team. Examples may include pictures and/or posters used in some of our environments.

Was a big fan of this game and put a decent amount of hours into it with friends over the past couple years. However, the dishonesty of Red Barrels regarding inclusion of AI is a big turn off and puts any future updates in doubt. Shame too because they did have plenty of real human artists, voice actors, and creatives working on this but, undoubtedly, some higher up executive wanted to save money by introducing slop. They didn't even take the "oops my bad teehee" approach other studios are using when they got caught. Anyways, ♥♥♥♥ AI and support human made art.

I absolutely love this game but the fact they use ai has thrown me off this game completely, if the ai art is ever removed and replaced with real art I might come back to this game but sadly I don't see them ever changing it.
a game that was fun that has now succumb to AI generated slop. a total of 486 assets in the game are AI generated.  do better red barrels.

The Outlast trials is a 4 player co-op horror survival game that really *emphasizes* the horror, unlike many other co-op horror survivors out on steam. The game can genuinely be frightening in both its shock content and its more latent tense moments.

By far The outlast trials strongest factor, for me, is its fantastic story building and lore, The documents you collect throughout the trial chambers and the facility as a whole really makes it feel like it's a living breathing place. The outlast trails is the only example of a live service game that actually FEELS ALIVE, in my opinion. Although the inclusion of some offline accessible mode would have been appreciated.

Gameplay wise, It’s pretty fun! Although I only see myself playing with friends rather than by myself or by joining others' lobbies. Otherwise, exploring the environment while you’re running away from the, to put it lightly, fantastic and colorful cast of characters you're put up against is good fun.

Lastly, the main thing holding back the outlast trials score, in my opinion, is the usage of generative AI in the final product. While not inherently blatant and apparent in gameplay, I cannot reasonably rate a game in good faith without addressing it and docking points. Even if the assets are placeholders or adjusted.

Overall, 7/10 The outlast franchise is great and the trials add onto it in a compelling way. Making The outlast trials offline accessible and removing GenAI assets would diagnose the few problems I have with this game.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term participants navigate server latency and artificial intelligence asset creation while utilizing earned currency.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe encountering server issues, including lag, high latency, and rubberbanding during matches.

citations.review_text:
Outlast trials is my favorite game of all time. No, genuinely.

But i cannot in good consciousness give the game a positive review so long as they are using GenAI. The Outlast Trials community is one of the best and most passionate communities i have been a part of, and has ironically is filled to the brim with artists. So many people are willing to do the art for the game.

The irony is not lost on me either. Outlast Trials is a game about power, corruption, and control over a society where exploitation and human greed is a common theme. Embarrassing, Red Barrels.

Overall (IMO) the game just needs an update where they fix these long term issues (not just the AI, but the large issue with servers having lag and rubberbanding) instead of focusing on making new content, whether or not its all at once or in small hot fixes.

Nearly unplayable, for reference everything here is with a wired connection and 30-35 ping because I know how the devs like to blame everyone else
This game shouldn't be for sale with how awful the servers are. Every game will have you sliding around like the floor is ice, you will be teleported around, the enemies will be teleported around, projectiles phase through people, enemies will change on a whim whether they spotted you or not. Walking upstairs? Well the game thought that might be a bit advanced for its tastes so you'll just have to stand at the bottom picking your nose while the homeless man stabs you
It has been like this for nearly a year with no word from the devs just them blaming the players who report it

Genuinely an extremely well crafted game with a lot of care in the lore, skins, maps, and enemies- and ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ the voice acting is phenomenal. The gameplay is very enjoyable, even when doing the same trials over and over again to get tickets/ tasks done or play with friends. The community is very kind! Initially I found a lot of the early gameplay and first times in challenges getting jumped by enemies very scary, but! It got funnier surprisingly. It's satisfying watching bricks bounce of Franco's forehead mid-chase to leave after pulling off the worst escape known to mankind. 

My only genuine gripe is when the servers get busy there's enough of a lag that makes it genuinely hard to do much of anything, including just trying to maneuver in the lobby to buy upgrades or read lore docs. It's rare- but noticeable.

I’m leaving this review out of pure frustration. I used to thoroughly enjoy The Outlast Trials when we had dedicated Middle East servers. The gameplay was smooth and intense. However, after they removed the ME servers, the game became an absolute nightmare for the wrong reasons constant lag, high latency, and unplayable matches in a game that literally requires precise timing to survive.

On top of that, their customer support team is complete garbage. They ignore player feedback and offer zero help. It’s a shame to see a good game ruined by terrible server management and awful support. Avoid this game if you are from ME until they fix their infrastructure.

Absolutely fantastic with friends and can be super fun with randoms. Honestly only real gripe is server lag and rubberbanding even in singleplayer but the rest of the game is absolutely good enough to ignore it also insanely good monetization considering how much content you get in this game
Game is fun and works but servers sometimes have issues with rubberbanding.

Great game, especially if you love survival games like DBD. Amazing quality and details, sometimes too amazing. Only complaint is how laggy the servers are sometimes. I'm still not sure how to feel about watching my character jump down the stairs before getting teleported back and bent over a pool table while my trusted adult is across the map LOL
feels like i lag more on this game than marvel rivals but its chill

But i cannot in good consciousness give the game a positive review so long as they are using GenAI. The irony is not lost on me either. Outlast Trials is a game about power, corruption, and control over a society where exploitation and human greed is a common theme. Embarrassing, Red Barrels.

Overall (IMO) the game just needs an update where they fix these long term issues (not just the AI, but the large issue with servers having lag and rubberbanding) instead of focusing on making new content, whether or not its all at once or in small hot fixes.

I love this game dearly. It’s become my new obsession. It’s the one live service game I’ll occasionally give money too because I want to see more, but recently learning they’ve been using AI to make assets and not just a few, hundreds, I’m appalled. They won’t be getting a penny or second of my time anymore. I don’t care if they are replaced later because it does not replace the water and electricity used to make this slop. 
Red Barrels, you have an amazing creative team and I understand you are not a huge studio, but I’m certain most of your player base would be okay waiting longer for seasons for you to make actual art rather than burning through our natural resources we need on this planet to survive. 
I’m incredibly disappointed. I loved this game, its community, the lore and setting, but I can’t support a game that selfishly replaces labor for cheap AI generated content that is actively destroying the world. 
Do better Red Barrels, until then, I’m done supporting you.

Can't believe they ruined the game by using gen AI. So completely stupid because there are so many talented artists who would be willing to do the art they claim they're using AI for. Nobody wants soulless slop from a machine in their game about corruption, power, and control over society through exploitation, capitalism, and human greed. Pull yourselves together Red Barrels it's seriously embarrassing.
whenever you get bored playing this game just remember by the end you can unlock another AI generated decoration for your room

The Outlast Trials isn't a game for everyone. It is chock-full of gore, and you can't go five steps without seeing some kind of atrocity. That being said, it's a *good* game. The focus isn't on the gore, it's on what's going on around you, and what you need to do. The characters are intoxicatingly charismatic, and I feel like this is one of the best multiplayer horror games to ever exist. It runs well, even on my ♥♥♥♥-box PC, and I like the direction the game is going. Small caveat: There IS AI ART in some of the game's posters. While I can overlook that, many people would be very upset by it.
fun asf, but ai assets

claims.claim: Reviewers note that in-game currency earned from starting play allows purchasing battle passes and catalogs without additional spending.

citations.review_text:
my favorite co-op horror game ever <3 I love how the level system works, where you get a random cosmetic so that everyone has a different outfit or room customized. you never really need to pay for anything in the game, because the starting currency allows you to get every pass that costs 1000. i personally love difficulty a lot and this game absolutely has it for anyone who wants it, but it's really nice how it's not really a requirement at all, with the rewards only being slightly increased from the base difficulty. this game has some of my favorite gameplay ever, technically being a horror asym but only against really smart ai (though there is a ranked PvP version if wanted as a side part of the game). the stealth is so enjoyable to make use of in this game, hiding around in the dark like in the outlast series!! you're able to traverse around in the dark, but the enemies don't have night vision like you do

if any of my friends are looking at this review, i'm dying to have people to play this game with! it usually goes on sale for twelve USD :3 this game is like if it took all the outlast series being some of the most renowned horror games ever, and turned it into the most fun co-op to suffer through with friends

Holy Gooseberry this game right here is what has officially started my rabbit hole down the Outlast Franchise. The Outlast Trials is what I can only describe to be the most entertaining online horror games I've ever got to play even when playing solo.

I mostly play co-op and have really grown closer to my partner because of the fun times we have had in this game. However if you want to be scared go play the original outlast I've barley gotten an hour in and that ♥♥♥♥ scares me. This can be scary but mostly if you are alone or if you are under psychosis, (game de-buff), and unable to find antidote.

All and all the game has great character design, lore, voice acting, and motion capture work. Red Barrels really did a good job here in my opinion. However I hope the next outlast continues the single player saga. 

Last thing I got to add. You don't have to buy a dam thing. The microtransactions are not predatory and I've unlocked multiple catalogs without having to spend a dime. I am very happy about this because the progression in the game feels very fun and fulfilling and when you complete a milestone or even a secret task ohhh you get rewarded!

Well optimized, frequent updates, almost everything in game can be purchased without having to spend an additional cent with realistic playtime. Probably the best model of a live service game currently out there.
